name: jvmscope
description: Live debugging UI for running JVMs: attach to a Java PID (local or in a Kubernetes pod), browse its decompiled source in an embedded VS Code, and drive Arthas watch/trace/time-tunnel from a form-based UI.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @jvmscope/core run build && pnpm --filter @jvmscope/preload run build && pnpm --filter @jvmscope/main run build && pnpm --filter @jvmscope/renderer run build
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @jvmscope/main exec electron ./dist/index.js
